title: Plynth project pack, version 1
description: pack/pack.json, written by plynth pack and the app's Pack project: the library items a project uses, so the project can move to another machine and be unpacked into its library. Copied items have their files under pack/; references are only named, because they came from a store, their origin is not known, their license does not allow sharing, or they are generator scripts. The file holds no absolute path.

created.description: When the pack was written, UTC.

room_types.description: The custom room types the project uses, added to the other library when it lacks them.

state.description: copied: the files are in the pack. reference: only named. missing: the project uses it but the library did not have it.

reason.description: Why it is not copied. Left out for a copied entry.

license.description: The license id, for assets and materials.

source.description: Where an asset or material came from, as in its info.json.

files.description: Paths relative to pack/, with forward slashes, inside the entry's own folder: assets/<id>/, materials/<id>/ or shapes/. Empty unless copied.
